label: Shelly Fleet Dashboard
info:
Shelly fleet dashboard for FlowFuse Dashboard 2.0 (@flowfuse/node-red-dashboard), built on the outputs of the shelly-admin nodes.

SETUP
1. Select the seven link-out nodes on the left ("Shelly → Dashboard …"), cut them (Ctrl+X), paste them (Ctrl+V) into the tab that contains your shelly-admin nodes and wire:
   Discovery   output 1 → Inventory, output 2 → Events, output 3 → Errors
   Monitor     output 1 → Health,    output 2 → Alerts, output 3 → Errors
   Maintenance output 1 → Maintenance result, output 2 → Maintenance progress, output 3 → Errors
2. Move the three link-in nodes on the right ("Dashboard command → …") into the same tab and connect each to the INPUT of the matching node.
   Link connections are kept when cutting and pasting.
3. Deploy and open /dashboard/shellies, then click "Check inventory".

EXISTING DASHBOARD 2.0
Only one ui-base is supported per Node-RED instance. If you already use Dashboard 2.0, delete the imported ui-base "Shelly Admin" from the configuration nodes and assign the page "Shellies" to your own dashboard.

SWITCHING
Relays and plugs (up to 4 channels) are read and switched directly via the local Shelly API:
  Gen2+: /rpc/Shelly.GetStatus, /rpc/Shelly.GetConfig, /rpc/Switch.Set
  Gen1:  /status, /settings, /relay/N?turn=on|off
Devices of class "critical" need a second click. Password-protected devices: set authentication in the "Shelly HTTP" node (Digest for Gen2+, Basic for Gen1, user admin).

SAFETY
Firmware updates and reboots only while maintenance is unlocked in the dashboard (10 min), for selected devices only, max. 5 per command, two-step confirmation; the maintenance node receives confirm:true. Firmware check and dry run are read-only.

PERSISTENCE
Model and 24 h history use the "file" context store when configured (fallback: default store).
